manual.blueprint.page1:
[1 - Blueprint]

Hold the item and
right-click two
corners to mark
the area.

Sneak-click block
clears the pick.
manual.blueprint.page2:
[2 - Origin]

Right-click block:
sets the origin.

Right-click air:
turns it.

Sneak-click air to
open the panel.
manual.blueprint.page3:
[3 - Hand it over]

Put the blueprint
in her main hand,
off hand or bag -
all three work.

Set her task to
[Blueprint Builder].

Then she goes off
to build.
manual.blueprint.page4:
[4 - Study mode]

Craft things near
her and she learns
them into her
study pool.

One product can
hold many recipes.
manual.blueprint.page5:
[5 - Industry]

She works from her
pool: fetch, make,
put results back
in her bag.

No materials? She
says so.
manual.blueprint.page6:
[6 - Study pool]

Hold a stick and
sneak-click your
own maid.

(Empty-handed sneak
+ click is a kiss.)

Search, switch
recipes or order.
manual.blueprint.page7:
[7 - Her materials]

She looks in this
order:
1 nearby chests
2 her wireless
  terminal (needs an
  ME network)
3 bound container

Then her own bag.
manual.blueprint.page8:
[8 - Building]

She walks outside
the build first,
then places block
by block.

Her own cell stays
empty - she won't
bury herself.
manual.blueprint.page9:
[9 - Progress bar]

The bar names the
build and shows
blocks left.

The line under it:
what she is doing.

Other maids nearby
add a count.
manual.blueprint.page10:
[10 - Her speed]

Base: 5 a second.

+1 per 5 favor,
up to 20.

So spending time
with her pays off.
manual.blueprint.page11:
[11 - She is stuck]

Look at the line
under the bar:

Fetching - no
materials, or the
terminal's offline

Walking - heading
outside to build
manual.blueprint.page12:
[When unsure]

Open logs/latest.log
and search for
[蓝图施工].

Every 30s she logs
one line: state,
progress, spot,
fetch target.
Paste it and the
cause is clear.
